fusions.name: Rivet Splitter
fusions.desc: A stone-weighted blow aimed at the joins of the target's armour, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Rampart Shove
fusions.desc: You thrust a wall-shield of stone out ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead and knocking it 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Strata Guard
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 12 seconds, and you carry 10% physical resistance.

fusions.name: Grown Plating
fusions.desc: Conjures plate grown from jagged stone: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 12%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
